title: State-Machine DP

story.briefing: Charge can be bought and sold across the cycle, one unit at a time, but the regulator needs a full cycle to cool after every sale. Maximise the profit.
story.success: Trading plan optimal. The regulator never overheats, and the Core banks the difference.

description: You are given the price of a charge unit on each cycle. You may buy and sell repeatedly, but you may hold at most one unit at a time, you must sell before buying again, and after any sale you must skip at least one cycle before buying. Return the largest total profit achievable. Doing nothing earns 0.

examples.explanation: Buy at 1, sell at 3, cool down, buy at 0, sell at 2.
Prices only fall, so do nothing.

hints: At the end of every cycle you are in exactly one of three situations: holding a unit, just sold one, or free to buy. Track the best profit for each.
The cooldown is what forces the third state to exist. Without it, "just sold" and "free to buy" would be the same thing — and your answer would be too high.

Sweep the prices updating three running values. Holding comes from staying held or buying while free. Just-sold comes from selling what you held. Free comes from staying free or from yesterday just-sold. The answer is the best of the two non-holding states.
